author: yungmuck
body: Hi, I was recently temp banned for rudeness and I understand the things I said as well as I made the report and log checks were requested, but id like to apologise for the rude and disrespectful things I said ingame and wanted to know if it would be possible to shorten my ban. As well as the things I say it was the spur of the moment and I was a bit angry from the rude things said by another player. If its not possible to shorten my ban I completely understand and again I'm very sorry.

title: Banned :(

replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
The temporary ban itself is not long, and it's very rare/doesn't happen when it comes to shortening these types of punishments. Thank you for an apology though.

Denying this appeal.

-John
